content:
dana: Heads up — rolling OOB firmware delta to BMCs in eu-west started at 14:00 UTC and failed on ~30 hosts. TFTP apply hangs around 90% on the delta step.
hiro: any immediate impact to GPU capacity?
dana: yes. 2 racks in eu-west lost boot after reboot, secureboot appears toggled ON during apply on those hosts. ~64 GPUs out, autoscaler tried to backfill but we hit regional quota.
sam: can you paste the error?
dana: logs from one host:
```
Apr 07 14:02:12 bmc[proc]: tftp: recvfrom: Message too long
Apr 07 14:02:12 bmc[proc]: apply-delta: commit timeout
Apr 07 14:02:13 ipmi: secureboot: state change requested -> ON
Apr 07 14:02:14 kernel: firmware: write failed: -22
```
kevin: Message too long -> likely MTU fragmentation on management network. Vendor delta server probably sending bigger TFTP packets / relying on jumbo frames. Our mgmt VLAN MTU is 1500.
ara: on a couple of the affected BMCs, the flash got marked read-only (flash lock set) after partial apply. That blocks rollback via HTTP/TFTP.
mike: vendor said their delta assumes 9000 MTU on mgmt fabric. They pushed it in CI but didn't test our MSO topology. :grimacing:
dana: immediate mitigation: paused the rollout, set affected hosts to maintenance in fleet manager, and started manual rollback attempts using oob-console and scp fallback image where possible.
sam: step for manual recovery? short checklist please.
dana: 1) oob-console -> NMI and interrupt boot. 2) use serial-over-lan to push full image via SCP (`scp -oKexAlgorithms=+diffie-hellman`), 3) `ipmitool mc reset cold` after image verified. 4) clear secureboot variable if boot fails.
kevin: I'll add a preflight MTU check to fw-rollout.sh: `ip route get --dev $MGMT_IF` + test tftp-size. If MTU < 9000, warn and fallback to chunked HTTP.
ara: long-term: vendor to provide delta slices that respect 1500 MTU and not toggle secureboot flags unless explicit flag set. Also add flash-lock detection preflight.
mike: impact estimate: we lost ~150 GPU-hours while remediating (eu-west). Autoscaler spun up nodes in us-east -> cross-region egress + spot churn cost ~ $1.2k, rough calc.
dana: opened incident ticket and vendor escalation. ops-bot, please create INC and page infra oncall.
ops-bot: Created INC-2025-084: eu-west OOB firmware delta failures. Oncall paged.
hiro: are there customer-facing outages?
dana: not customer-facing  SLA-wise — most traffic shifted to other regions. Latency-sensitive jobs degraded. We should notify support for possible tenant impact in eu-west.
sam: I'll draft a short customer note and flag high-priority jobs we should migrate.
kevin: after rollback, I'll run a canary of 4 hosts with `--mtu-check` disabled then re-run with `--mtu-check` enabled to validate.
ara: also adding a preflight that checks `ipmitool fru` and `ipmitool mc info` to detect BMCs with known flash-lock bug.
dana: assigning postmortem owner and vendor call. Will capture timeline, costs, and recommend: preflight MTU check, secureboot-preserve flag, vendor delta fix, and update runbook.
mike: thumbs up. :thumbsup:
dana: thanks all — keeping thread for postmortem notes.
